verdict.rationale: Render's own docs list "Docker support", and independent users praise "great docker support" and "easy Docker", so Render itself provides Docker-based deployment. The first-party evidence is only a section heading, so how Docker deploys work is not shown. missing for 10: documented details of Dockerfile builds or deploying prebuilt images from a registry, a step-by-step container deploy workflow, and any stated limitations of Docker support.

support.subject: As a developer, I can deploy applications packaged as Docker containers

citations.quote: In addition to great docker support and free static sites
